info.title: ARCHIVED BACKUP - Kitten Nest Text Target Actions
info.description: ARCHIVED BACKUP ONLY. The current all-window ChatGPT Kitten Nest App uses /api/mcp and update_text_target, with targetIds read from data/text-targets.v1.json. Do not treat this OpenAPI file as the primary integration route unless a separate external REST Actions integration is explicitly requested.

post.summary: Archived backup: write or dry-run a registered Kitten Nest text target through /api/set-state
post.description: Backup REST/OpenAPI contract. Primary current route is /api/mcp. Target enum here may lag behind the registry; prefer /api/mcp and data/text-targets.v1.json for all-window ChatGPT App work.

targetId.description: Registered text target id. For current authoritative target list, read data/text-targets.v1.json.

text.description: Text to write. Bubble queues use one non-empty line per bubble. windowWeather uses line 1 as temperature and line 2 as description.

dryRun.description: When true, returns the patch without writing state. Keep true unless explicitly testing this archived REST route.

200.description: Archived backup response. Current MCP route may return a different compact MCP tool result.
